normal_speed_viewing.reason: No actual normal-speed video viewing surface was available to this reviewer. Still inspection is not playback.

source_composition.assessment: The large right-cropped pig, left-facing start, forward movement of the snout, and increasingly close framing broadly follow the six source samples.

source_pose.assessment: The source turns from left profile into a three-quarter approach. Especially in pairs 05 and 06, the cartoon retains a long flat profile face with the tiny spiral snout on its extreme left edge; it does not convincingly express the source head turning toward the viewer.

original_doodle_identity.assessment: The angular double-peaked ears, tiny square spiral snout, sparse black outline, broad polygonal body, and loose dangling leg-stroke grammar remain recognizably those of design.png.

single_most_important_gap: The late head remains a side-profile doodle while the source head has turned toward the camera.
smallest_repair: In the late keys, foreshorten the existing head outline and shift the same spiral snout inward relative to the ear pair so the face reads as a three-quarter turn. Keep the original spiral, angular ears, sparse strokes, and body treatment; add no facial features or new style.
strengths_to_preserve: Recognizable original doodle marks and sparse line weight.
Large subject scale, right crop, and broad source-aligned snout trajectory.
motion_verdict: Withheld: no actual normal-speed viewing was performed.
overall_verdict: Original doodle identity passes; broad composition passes; source pose needs the small late head-turn repair. Motion approval is withheld.
